A laparoscopic view shows internal tissue with a large, pale, rounded mass in the center and several smaller, bright orange masses in the lower foreground. The surrounding tissue is pinkish and purplish.

Two silver instruments are present; one is a retractor holding back tissue, and the other is a pair of forceps/tweezers manipulating a reddish mass. A white, round object is visible in the lower right portion of the frame.
